description: Source code for managing multi-pack index (MIDX) files in a Git-like version control system, including loading, validation, and verification of MIDX files.

methods.name: get_midx_checksum
methods.description: Returns the checksum of the multi-pack index.

methods.name: get_midx_filename
methods.description: Constructs the filename for the midx file.

methods.name: get_midx_filename_ext
methods.description: Constructs the filename for the midx file with optional hash and extension.

methods.name: load_multi_pack_index_one
methods.description: Loads a single midx file into memory.

methods.name: load_multi_pack_index
methods.description: Attempts to load the midx file or its chain.

methods.name: close_midx
methods.description: Frees resources associated with a midx.

methods.name: midx_checksum_valid
methods.description: Validates the checksum of a midx.

methods.name: verify_midx_file
methods.description: Verifies the integrity and order of a midx file.
